content: By leasing its dense urban Wi-Fi infrastructure to cellular providers seeking to alleviate network congestion, Bioniq is opening a new, lucrative channel of wholesale revenue. Vcom — Aerial Fibre Network Operator (FNO) Revenue Model The organizational and operational architecture of a corporate entity is fundamental to its capacity for sustainable market penetration and financial consolidation. Operating under a traditional holding company model, Veramani IT Holding Company functions primarily as an oversight and financial consolidation entity rather than engaging directly in the production or delivery of consumer services. The primary revenue flow mechanism for the holding company is defined as subsidiary revenue aggregation. The revenue flow mechanism for Vcom is categorized as aerial fibre network revenue, which is subsequently channeled upward into the parent company's subsidiary revenue aggregation system. The market environment in which Vcom operates, particularly within regions like South Africa, provides a robust backdrop for its revenue-generating capabilities. The demand for high-speed internet connectivity has catalyzed substantial growth in fibre infrastructure. Industry projections indicate a 22 percent increase in Fibre-to-the-Home and Fibre-to-the-Business (FTTH/B) lines, reaching an estimated 3.01 million active connections by the end of 2026 [22] . Concurrently, overall fixed broadband lines are projected to experience a 19.3 percent rise, culminating in 3.26 million connections [22] . While these figures represent the aggregate expansion of both aerial and underground installations, they underscore the expansive addressable market available to operators like Vcom. The financial viability of Vcom's operational model is further supported by broader global insights into the fibre optic market. The global fibre optic industry is projected to experience substantial expansion, growing from an estimated 8.73 billion USD in 2026 to approximately 18.44 billion USD by the year 2034 [24] . This trajectory represents a compound annual growth rate of 9.8 percent, indicating sustained, long-term demand for high-capacity network infrastructure [24] . For Veramani IT Holding Company, the aerial fibre network revenue generated by Vcom constitutes a vital component of its subsidiary revenue aggregation.
